ai_review.summary: The board scores 70/100 — Moderate Quality. 5 issue(s) require attention before fabrication.

issues_detail.title: Unconnected Pads
issues_detail.explanation: 8 unconnected pad(s) detected. Unconnected pads may result in open circuits and board malfunction. Every pad should be connected to its intended net before fabrication.

issues_detail.title: DRC Violations
issues_detail.explanation: 5 DRC violation(s) detected. DRC violations indicate that the design may fail manufacturing constraints such as minimum clearance, minimum annular ring, or track spacing rules.

issues_detail.title: High Via Density
issues_detail.explanation: Via count (60) exceeds 40% of track count (120). High via density may increase manufacturing complexity, raise production costs, and degrade signal integrity due to additional layer transitions.

issues_detail.title: Thin Tracks Detected
issues_detail.explanation: 3 track(s) below recommended minimum width (< 0.25 mm). Thin tracks can cause signal integrity issues and may not survive the etching process during manufacturing.

issues_detail.title: Small Via Drill Sizes
issues_detail.explanation: 2 via(s) with drill size below 0.4 mm. Very small vias increase drilling difficulty and may lead to unreliable barrel plating.

recommendations_detail: Run DRC (Design Rule Check) and fix all violations before fabrication.
Review the netlist and ensure every pad is connected to its intended net. Use the ratsnest display to locate open connections.
Reduce unnecessary layer transitions by optimising trace routing. Consider re-routing critical nets on fewer layers.
Increase track widths to at least 0.25 mm (10 mil). Use wider tracks for power nets to improve current-carrying capacity.
Increase via drill sizes to at least 0.4 mm to improve manufacturing yield and reliability.
Review power and ground routing for adequate copper width.
Perform a final visual inspection of the board layout before generating Gerber files.
ai_review.fabrication_details: The board is not ready for fabrication due to: 5 DRC violation(s); 8 unconnected pad(s). Fix these issues and re-run the analysis.
